security.description: How ecentic handles your catalog, your store access and your customers’ data. We update this page as we grow, and the date below changes when we do.

sections.title: Last updated 10 November 2026
sections.description: This page describes the controls in the current product. Deployment details still awaiting confirmation are marked below.

sections.title: How we touch your store
paragraphs: Importing product content does not rewrite it. Apply generates and publishes a title and description on a directly connected Shopify or WooCommerce store. Structured data uses a separate publish action. Connecting Shopify also installs the visit-tracking script.
If you connect Merchant Center for Shopify, ecentic adds a supplemental data source for published fixes and checkout attributes. It does not replace your main feed.

On Shopify, a storefront script records visits when it detects an AI assistant referrer or a known agent user-agent. It sends the full page URL, browser user-agent, referrer, page type, detected agent and detection method, and an available product identifier. The record includes the store and the time received.
This browser script observes visits that run JavaScript. It does not measure every crawler request or establish that a later order came from the same shopper.

Shopify access uses the Shopify Admin API and the permissions shown on the install screen. You can uninstall at any time. WooCommerce connects through the ecentic plugin or REST API keys that you create and can revoke.

When you enable agent checkout on WooCommerce, the checkout bridge creates real orders in your store. Your gateway takes payment and you remain merchant of record. Agent checkout supports signed requests, agent allow-lists and configurable rate limits; enforcement follows your store settings.
Enterprise pilots can start from public pages and product data, without access to your systems.

sections.title: AI models and your data
paragraphs: The product catalog you connect is sent to AI providers to compare listings and write fixes. Store scans use ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. GPT also generates listing rewrites and structured data. Perplexity is used in the separate comparison and discovery tools, not store scans.
GPT runs through Azure OpenAI when an Azure deployment is configured. Anthropic, Google and Perplexity requests use the Vercel AI Gateway; GPT can use that gateway as a fallback.
Data read from a connected Google Merchant Center account is kept separate from the store catalog used for AI work, as described in the privacy policy.

about.title: We build the commerce layer for AI shoppers.
about.description: Three founders who have built together for seven years. ecentic exists because when AI does the shopping, a store needs to be ready for a customer that reads data instead of pages.

sections.title: Why we started
paragraphs: Whether people search Google, shop on Amazon or ask a chatbot, AI now answers with a product. Most stores have no idea how to be that product. They can’t see the decision, they can’t see why they lost it, and their analytics count the traffic as direct. We started ecentic to show stores that decision and help them fix it, product by product.

faqs.question: Are these tools really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The AI Agent Score is a one-time free scan with no credit card. The validator is free, and the playground includes ten messages without an account. Ongoing optimization follows the plans on the pricing page.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to use the checkout tools?
faqs.answer: The UCP Validator works without signing in. The UCP Playground gives you ten free messages without an account. Sign in to continue testing your connected store within the product’s limits.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the UCP Validator and the Playground?
faqs.answer: The Validator checks the published checkout profile and whether the endpoint can be reached. The Playground runs an AI agent through supported catalog, cart and checkout operations so you can inspect its tool calls and responses.

faqs.question: Where should I start if I am new to agent commerce?
faqs.answer: Start with the free store check if you have a Shopify or WooCommerce catalog. To check checkout support first, run the Validator on your domain, then read the platform overview.
